name: Serperior
description: Serperior, the Regal Pokémon, and the evolved form of Servine. A Grass type.
pokedex_entries: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.
It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior's noble eyes.
